package flaky

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestPass(t *testing.T) {}

func TestFail(t *testing.T) { t.Fatal("deliberate failure") }

func TestSkip(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("deliberate skip") }

func TestTable(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("one", func(t *testing.T) {})
	t.Run("two/nested", func(t *testing.T) {
		if os.Getenv("FLAKY_FAIL") != "" {
			t.Fatal("flaky")
		}
	})
}
